# Janet 1.41.2, amalgamated

The runtime, vendored. Three files, straight from the official release:

    https://github.com/janet-lang/janet/releases/tag/v1.41.2

    janet.c   the whole interpreter, generated by Janet's own amalgamation
    janet.h   its public header
    shell.c   the `janet` command-line program

`sha256`, as downloaded:

    2a0afcbe83823025c67899a867017095565f8a0a51851ab2507c9416ff3246b7  janet.c
    b82d7415df6826bdc3207624c56425bbfa5d783b88658330e58413f1f562f3e5  janet.h
    63c964253bbed159ecb1df890202278402f556260f56ee8014ce50bfbd6f2834  shell.c

Verify them with:

    shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS

## Why these are here

So that a clone of this repository builds offline, and builds the same runtime
in a year. The amalgamated distribution needs a C99 compiler and libc and
nothing else -- no autotools, no CMake, no package manager, no network. `../..
/build` compiles it in a few seconds and only when it is not already compiled.

## Do not edit these files

They are generated. `janet.c` says so on its first line. To move to a
different Janet, replace all three from that version's release page, update
the checksums above, and run `./build --force`.
